excerpt.zh: 我们的舰队有点弱不禁风。在宇宙中有各种各样的危险，需要我们用武力手段进行回应。要记住，我们的文明时刻处于危险之中！
excerpt.en: I can't help but notice that our navy is a bit on the weak side. We are certain to face many threats in the galaxy that will require some form of military response. Remember, the survival of our civilization is at stake!
